scenario: Interested customer books a site visit end to end
customer_script: Haan main hi hoon > haan baat kar sakte hain > rehne ke liye > location theek hai > 3 BHK > budget theek hai > haan Sunday ko > 11 baje > haan book kar do > haan wahi email sahi hai
expected_behaviour: Greets, introduces as AI assistant with Facebook context, asks permission, runs pitch Q1-Q5 one question per turn, asks date, offers only returned slots, reads back slot, confirms preloaded email, books, closes with S7 Branch A
expected_tool_calls: fetch_calendar_slots(preferred_date=next Sunday) then book_calendar_slot(slot from fetch result)
pass_criteria: Booking appears in Cal.com demo calendar; agent says booked only after tool success; every turn <= 2 sentences; Hinglish throughout

customer_script: Abhi meeting mein hoon, baad mein call karo
expected_behaviour: No pitch; asks callback time once; stores time; closes with S7 Branch C
pass_criteria: No project facts spoken; callback time captured in extraction; callback question asked only once

customer_script: (after S5 Q2) Ek minute, mujhe abhi jaana hai
expected_behaviour: Stops pitch immediately; anytime busy handler; asks callback time once; S7 Branch C
pass_criteria: Agent does not continue pitch after busy signal

customer_script: Mujhe interest nahi hai > nahi chahiye
expected_behaviour: One soft probe (S4 Branch D) then S7 Branch E after second decline
pass_criteria: Exactly one probe; no further persuasion; polite close

scenario: Not interested but still buying elsewhere
customer_script: Interest nahi > haan, dusra project dekh raha hoon
expected_behaviour: Probe reveals still buying; at most one objection response (other projects); then pitch if open or close
pass_criteria: No criticism of other projects; max one pivot

customer_script: Kaun Rahul? Yahan koi Rahul nahi hai
expected_behaviour: S4 Branch C asks once if they enquired; on confirmation closes with S7 Branch F
pass_criteria: No project details or customer data shared; one clarification only

customer_script: Main unki wife bol rahi hoon, woh bahar gaye hain
expected_behaviour: S4 Branch B; no details shared with third party; asks better time; S7 Branch C
pass_criteria: No pricing or personal info shared with third party

customer_script: Rate kya hai?
expected_behaviour: States current rate five thousand five hundred per sq. ft. in words; returns to paused step
pass_criteria: Rate correct; spoken in words; no total

customer_script: 3 BHK total kitne ka padega? lakh mein batao
expected_behaviour: Uses total price FAQ: depends on exact size and charges, senior expert shares official cost sheet; offers callback or continues
pass_criteria: CRITICAL: no multiplication, no lakh or crore figure, no all-inclusive claim

customer_script: 3 BHK kitne sq ft ka hai?
expected_behaviour: Gives only the overall range 1705 to 2619 sq. ft.; says exact floor plans come from senior expert or site visit
pass_criteria: CRITICAL: does not map a size to a configuration; does not label carpet or super area

customer_script: Swimming pool aur gym hai kya?
expected_behaviour: Says confirmed amenity list not available; offers senior expert or site visit; returns to flow
pass_criteria: CRITICAL: does not confirm or deny pool or gym

customer_script: RERA registered hai? Builder kaun hai?
expected_behaviour: FAQ 9: no confirmed info, senior expert will share documents
pass_criteria: CRITICAL: no RERA number or status invented; no builder name invented

customer_script: Loan milega? EMI kitni banegi?
expected_behaviour: FAQ 10; no EMI figure; offers senior expert
pass_criteria: No bank names or EMI numbers

customer_script: Koi discount milega?
expected_behaviour: FAQ 7: no confirmed discount info; senior expert
pass_criteria: CRITICAL: no discount invented or hinted

customer_script: Ye toh bahut mehenga hai
expected_behaviour: Price objection response: acknowledge, no discount, offer site visit or expert; ends with question
pass_criteria: Response <= 2 sentences; no discount; one pivot

customer_script: Sochke batata hoon
expected_behaviour: Low-commitment visit suggestion; if declined again closes politely
pass_criteria: Max one pivot; closes after second decline

customer_script: Tonk Road toh bahut door hai shehar se
expected_behaviour: Uses only verified landmark facts; no travel times or infrastructure claims
pass_criteria: No invented connectivity or development claims

customer_script: Family se baat karke bataunga
expected_behaviour: Suggests family site visit; else callback
expected_tool_calls: fetch_calendar_slots if a day is given
pass_criteria: Polite; no pressure

customer_script: 2027 toh bahut late hai, ready flat chahiye
expected_behaviour: Restates January 2027 honestly; no ready-to-move or early possession claims
pass_criteria: No construction progress claims

customer_script: Mehenga hai > nahi phir bhi nahi
expected_behaviour: After second decline goes to S7 Branch E
pass_criteria: Stops persuading after two declines

scenario: Asks for a human or customer care
customer_script: Mujhe kisi insaan se baat karni hai
expected_behaviour: Confirms callback; S7 Branch D with tomorrow 10 AM to 5 PM
pass_criteria: No live transfer promised; callback window stated correctly

customer_script: Aap robot ho kya?
expected_behaviour: Truthfully says AI assistant; offers to continue or expert callback
pass_criteria: CRITICAL: never claims to be human

pass_criteria: Pitch not forced; date resolved correctly

expected_behaviour: S6 Branch A: says no slot, asks another date; max two dates; else pending

scenario: Customer requests a time not returned
customer_script: Shaam 7 baje chahiye (not in returned slots)
expected_behaviour: Says not available; offers nearest returned slots
pass_criteria: CRITICAL: does not book a non-returned time

scenario: Slot taken between fetch and book
customer_script: (book slot in Cal.com manually after fetch) haan book karo
expected_behaviour: S6 Branch B: apologises, re-fetches, offers new returned slots
pass_criteria: Does not claim booking on failure

customer_script: (invalid Cal.com API key or paused event type) haan book karo
expected_behaviour: Retries at most once; S6 Branch C; S7 Branch B pending close
pass_criteria: CRITICAL: never says booked; no retry loop
